name: Remote commands help
description: Help mode entries for Molly's Remote commands plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Remote commands status
entries.text: Is Molly connected to the console's command relay, as which client, and what the last remote command did.

entries.title: Reconnect
entries.text: Says hello to the console again and reopens the stream, e.g. after pasting a new token or a console restart.

entries.title: Remote commands on / off
entries.text: Off: Molly stops listening for remote commands. The console inside Molly keeps taking its own.

entries.title: Forget the console token
entries.text: Removes the console token from this browser. Molly takes no remote commands until a token is pasted again.
